semanticChecks: Multidisciplinary coordination starts with resident wishes, observed difficulty and concrete consultation, not profession labels. PT basic movement/OT daily activities/ST language-communication-swallowing distinct; one difficulty may cross specialties. No sole-profession assumption, diagnosis, independently designed rehabilitation exercise or report-only food/drink change. Worker observations, normal differences, successful/difficult parts and conditions reported; unknown causes/diagnoses stay unknown. Sending/receiving/advice clarification/plan change remain separate. Recipient and task ownership/authorized changes checked before action; necessary information only.

Kai case preserves club-participation wish, hand arranging and group-speaking difficulties, vague PT-only one-line contact, cause/new plan unconfirmed. Paragraph and full reading variants separately complete, without merging their differing facts. No invented gender/age/kinship.

Resident words/subjective experience, worker observations and measured numbers are separate complementary sources. Observation time not proven symptom onset; unseen periods not invented. Worker heat impression/room temperature/resident temperature distinct; unmeasured stated. Near miss/no injury not risk removed. Unverified cause does not justify blame. Unsupported conclusions corrected transparently by facility method, not history erased. High urgency means assistance/contact not delayed for writing.

Lien case retains14:00, tired statement, two towel-folding interruptions, no measurement and unsupported room-heat→fever notation requiring correction/report to responsible person. No inferred confirmed fever, causal room heat or erased resident words/actions.

Hand hygiene method chosen by visible soil/prior contact/next task rather than convenience. Visible soil running water+soap, both hands/palms/backs/interdigits/thumbs/tips/nail surrounds, rings/watch facility rules; count alone not coverage. Rinse+appropriate drying, alcohol rubbing product quantity/method until dry and no early wiping retained. Dirty towel OR surface may recontaminate; gloves not substitute. Actual quantity/time/product/pathogen choice remains facility infection control/product instructions/workplace training. Full reading clean-supplies container and both colleague suggestions retained.

Worker capacity: posture alone cannot authorize solo moving. Resident ability/workspace/tools/headcount/task division and own pain/fatigue/unsafe condition matter. Responsible person receives own-state/training deficit; pain concealed may endanger both. Suitable lift/sliding sheet checked pre-use and trained method; warehouse presence not model skill/shared duties confirmed. Full-assistance lifting considers equipment and avoiding manual reliance. No lifting/pulling/moving/fulcrum technique taught; individual evaluation/handling/workplace training required, unknown method not solo-tested. Case/readings retain current back pain, requested repositioning, untrained sheet model and colleague posture-only assertion.

Disaster readiness includes usable route/communication/who supports whom/accessible information, not bag inventory alone. Roster name not accepted task; attendance not safe completion. Unreachable hearing-support responsible person and trolley-blocked impassable route distinct from inspected bag. Report recipient/task acceptance/remedial owner/when+how efficacy rechecked; assigned cleanup versus actual correction versus proven usable route/information/support outcomes separated. No invented alternate or universal earthquake/fire/wind-flood evacuation order. Emergency facility trained response/instructions not delayed for learning report.

Expression/silence only prompts nonleading inquiry, not sadness/anger/refusal diagnosis. Desire to participate distinct from environmental obstacles; noise/hunger/fatigue/anxiety may coexist. Meaningful choices and actual constraints consulted; activity count/praise not satisfaction proof. Desire alone today not all-future interaction refusal. Music case preserves little speech/door gaze, initial worker dislike inference, resident noise-related solo-listening wish AND song-selection wish, not no-motivation inference. Need models/face do not determine psychology or decision ability; individual plan and concrete information to necessary responsible person for continuing changes retained.

Memory encoding/retention/recall and semantic/episodic/procedural distinctions retain prior terminology. Familiar towel skill not proof of new schedule memory; failure once not diagnosis. First check accessible delivery/hearing/content+question understanding, noise not automatically causal. Observed skill/reply/explanation context/unknowns separate; short explanation/quiet place/usable communication discussed and result limited to task. Not dementia test or decision-capacity substitute. All full reading variants include their worker inference and uncertainty rather than summarizing paragraph cases.
